name: Alacritty
description: A fast, cross-platform, OpenGL terminal emulator.
summary: Alacritty forbids contributions containing content generated by large language models or other probabilistic tools, including Copilot or ChatGPT. The ban explicitly covers code, documentation, pull requests, issues, comments, and any other contributions.
